def equation(t, P, params):
    L=np.log(P)
    p=params
    return (p[0]/P + p[1]*P + p[2]*t*P + p[3]*P**2 + p[4]*t*P**2 + p[5]*P**3
            + p[6]*P*L + p[7]*t*P*L + p[8]*P**2*L + p[9]*t/P)
